name: How to Raise the Dead
source:
The second wave of the zombie apocalypse has finally left a long-standing community in tatters. Being the sole survivor of this tragic inevitability, our hero, Gennedy, must handle the rest of what the surviving realm has to offer. For better or worse, even when the world thrusts all means of strife upon you, one is never alone. 

Fortunately for the young Gen, she won't have to go too crazy talking to herself, as she finds another individual who's somehow made it through hell half-alive. Although her zombie friend should, by all means, be lost to all sense of reality, like her, he manages to hold on to some semblance of sanity. As such, the two embark on a mission to not only find a way to live, but also unravel the mysteries behind their circumstances.

[From [url=https://twirlybird.itch.io/how-to-raise-the-dead]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
第二波僵尸大灾难终于让一个长期存在的社区支离破碎。作为这一悲剧不可避免的唯一幸存者，我们的英雄根尼迪必须处理幸存领域所面临的其余问题。无论好坏，即使世界将一切冲突手段强加于你，一个人也永远不会孤单。

对于年轻的一代来说幸运的是，她不必太疯狂地自言自语，因为她找到了另一个人，他以某种方式半死不活地度过了地狱。尽管她的僵尸朋友应该像她一样失去所有的现实感，但他仍设法保持着某种理智的外表。因此，两人不仅要寻找生存之道，还要解开他们的处境背后的谜团。

[来自[url=https://twirlybird.itch.io/how-to-raise-the-dead]itch.io[/url]]
